name: Trap Tattoo
bio:
Trap Tattoo, hailing from the vibrant city of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is renowned for their exceptional skill in the art of lettering tattoos. Working out of Paradise Ink Studio, this artist captures the essence of bespoke typography on skin with precision and a creative flair that leaves clients mesmerized by the results. Whether it’s intricate script or bold block letters, Trap Tattoo's portfolio is a testament to their mastery of ink and needle.
Price: $
Current location: Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brazil
